Also return time_complexity for computing ONLY the optimum value using dynamic programming as O(n), O(n^2), or O(2^n), and auxiliary_space_for_value as O(1) or O(n). Reconstruction tie-breaking must be justified, not confused with choosing the largest individual weights.
